hero.title: Fixing Ladywood - for the people by the people
hero.paragraph1: Our mission is to provide food security to the residents of Ladywood Birmingham. We wish to provide the community this by making a website application where Ladywood residents can sign up to their closest foodbank and be notified to receive or donate food.

goals.title: Why do we exist?
goals.goal1: To provide food to the community
goals.goal3: To help those who need it
goals.goal4: to fix our streets looking like that ->
goals.goal5: And much more, view our goals page and start learning!
